jobs.cover_note:
I am applying for the Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer role at Cognizant.

With over 13 years of quality assurance and test automation experience, my background directly aligns with your core toolset. I have extensive hands-on experience building maintainable test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Java, and Cucumber BDD, alongside strong expertise in Playwright. Throughout my career, including my current work at MetaDesign Solutions Pvt. Ltd., I have designed scalable automation architectures using the Page Object Model, validated REST APIs, and integrated automated regression suites directly into CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions.

I look forward to discussing how my technical background in Java, BDD, and web automation can support Cognizant's testing initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent Advance your testing career while shaping digital finance with automation The Role Capco is growing our Engineering team and we're looking for experienced SDETs with a passion for delivering innovative solutions in financial services. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with cloud-native technologies, and collaborating in agile teams, we'd love to hear from you. As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) at Capco, you'll contribute to high-impact, client-facing projects that shape the future of financial services. You'll work alongside talented engineers, gain access to industry-leading training, and have opportunities to develop your expertise across multiple technology platforms and business domains within Financial Services & Energy. You'll also embrace AI-enabled ways of working, using approved AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity, accelerate test delivery, and enhance software quality while applying sound engineering judgement and responsible AI practices. What You'll Do Design and implement robust, reusable, and scalable test strategies and automation frameworks, applying AI-enabled engineering approaches where appropriate to improve efficiency and test coverage. Develop and maintain test artefacts, including test plans, specifications, automated scripts, and quality reporting to support end-to-end delivery. Manage test environments and generate reliable, consistent test data to support functional, integration, and regression testing. Execute UI and API automation using modern testing frameworks while integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver quality-first solutions, encouraging the responsible use of approved AI tools and automation to improve collaboration and engineering outcomes. What We're Looking For Strong knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Java , Scala , or JavaScript . Experience designing and building test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium , Cypress , Playwright, or equivalent technologies. Hands-on experience with UI and API automation, alongside a solid understanding of quality engineering practices. Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. Experience using AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, software quality, and testing standar
match_reasons: Excellent technical alignment with Java, Selenium, Playwright, and API automation
Strong seniority match with 13 years of QA automation and framework design experience
Solid background in CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Agile QA practices
jobs.recommendation_reason: Outstanding technical and experience match, but score and recommendation are moderated due to the London (Hybrid) location requiring local UK presence.
jobs.domain_reason: Role is explicitly for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) focused on UI and API automation frameworks, test strategies, and CI/CD integration.

critical_skills_to_learn.reason: Appears in 18 matched job descriptions. Given your existing mastery of TypeScript and Playwright, mastering Cypress will immediately close the single biggest gap in your automation tooling repertoire.

While you have solid GitHub Actions experience, enterprise companies still heavily rely on Jenkins for legacy and on-prem orchestration. Understanding declarative pipelines and Jenkinsfiles solidifies your enterprise CI/CD profile.

trending_in_qa: AI-augmented automated test generation and self-healing tests
Contract testing (e.g., Pact) for microservice ecosystems
Observability and OpenTelemetry integration into automated test runs

certifications_recommended.cert: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect - Associate
certifications_recommended.reason: For a 13-year senior engineer transitioning to Lead/Architect roles, demonstrating cloud architecture knowledge is significantly higher leverage than basic testing certifications.

certifications_recommended.cert: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer (CTAL-TAE)
certifications_recommended.reason: Validates enterprise-grade test automation architecture, framework evaluation, and operational governance at the senior/lead level.

quick_wins: Build a showcase Cypress framework using TypeScript on GitHub to directly address the #1 missing keyword from job matches.
Add Jenkins pipeline setup experience alongside your GitHub Actions skill on your resume to cover enterprise CI requirements.
Reframe your resume metrics around business impact, framework scalability, and cross-team test enablement to position yourself for Lead/Architect titles.
skill_gap.career_advice: With 13 years of experience covering mobile, web, API, and performance testing (K6), you have an exceptional full-stack QA profile. Your missing skills are purely incremental rather than foundational—Cypress is easily mastered within a couple of weeks given your Playwright and TypeScript background. Focus your positioning on QA Architect, Lead SDET, or Quality Engineering Manager roles. Emphasize architecture design, mentoring, cross-functional quality culture, and CI/CD governance rather than just hands-on execution.
